trigger_condition.note: D-014 RESOLVED (partial - still a judgment call, flag in defense): high_risk_subset is driven by diagnosis_category + id_suffix, both of which live only in the patient_support dataset (DI-001/DI-004/DI-007) - the same dataset evidence-pack.md's current assessment describes as the encrypted export requiring the application service credential. If encryption_key_acquired=false, that data is not actually readable to the attacker, so the high-risk basis does not hold and this obligation should not trigger. Does NOT affect DL-001 (see its own note) - Art.33's much lower bar is still cleared by the unconditionally-unencrypted account_profile dataset alone.
